advice: Baseline CBC, LFT, fasting lipids and urine pregnancy test before starting; repeat LFT/lipids at 1 month. Strict contraception for women during treatment and 1 month after. No blood donation. Avoid waxing and laser during therapy. Two reliable methods of contraception (women) with a negative pregnancy test before each monthly refill. Do not take doxycycline/minocycline or vitamin A supplements with isotretinoin (risk of raised intracranial pressure). Continue until a cumulative dose of about 120–150 mg/kg is reached.
name: Acne vulgaris (severe / nodulocystic)

rx.instr: After a fatty meal (0.3-0.5 mg/kg/day; adjust to weight)
Apply twice daily on face and body
